key_insight: β-TeO3 is predicted to be a wide-band-gap n-type semiconductor with exceptionally high work functions, reaching about 8 eV, making it attractive for charge-selective layers.
engineering_relevance: Its combination of wide gap and ultrahigh work function suggests use as a hole injection/extraction layer or transparent electrode in optoelectronic devices such as solar cells and LEDs.
method: Screening of interstitial and substitutional impurities for donor behavior.
Work-function evaluation on multiple low-index nonpolar surfaces, including surface O-vacancy configurations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, Zn, and F act as shallow donors, while O vacancies locally trap electrons and can lower surface work functions.
watch_item: Performance will depend strongly on oxygen chemical potential because surface O-vacancy formation is energetically favorable and may reduce the desired ultrahigh work function.
paper_title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
